model_or_product: Fuzz; wah-wah pedal/effects kits; related effects
evidence_summary: Period and historical sources identify Charlie Ramskir's Wilsic Sound/Wilsic Electronics operation in Doncaster as an actual effects-building concern. Wilsic supplied Hornby Skewes fuzz products and also offered a Wilsic-branded fuzz. Contemporary 1971-1972 advertisements document Wilsic Sound effects kits, including a wah-wah pedal kit, while Fuzzboxes documents the firm's own-branded fuzz and its production relationship with Hornby Skewes. Preserve Wilsic as a builder/manufacturer lineage separate from Hornby Skewes, whose role was primarily marketed/distribution for the Zonk family.
